note: vibrance weights its boost by s instead of 1 - s, so saturated pixels move most, caught by ColorAdjustTests.lowSaturationMovesMost
vibrance drops the skin damping, so skin hues move as much as others, caught by ColorAdjustTests.skinMovesHalf
hsl range weights take the cosine over one neighbour's span on both sides, so they no longer sum to 1, caught by ColorAdjustTests.rangeWeightsSumToOne
